name: HRC_DL_REM_ENTITIES
description: SEED Table for Storing individual Business Objects for in HDL Hierarchy

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Entity Type UPDATE/DELETE for data disposal

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description:
A- Always enabled. Can't be disabled by the Customer.
Y - Enabled
N - Disabled

columns.name: LOCAL_VO_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Current VO Attribute Matching the Worker's Hierarchy.

columns.name: DATA_QUERY
columns.description: For Transient Objects, Query will have to be provided by Product Teams

columns.name: ENTITY_HASH
columns.description: HASH Generated afresh each time the product definition got modified

columns.name: OVERRIDE_QUERY
columns.description: If product team wants to override the default surrogate key fetching using person Id. Product teams can make use of this query to populate the local surrogate keys

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REF_BUSINESS_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key to HRC_DL_BUSINESS_OBJECTS  - Referring Business Object ID
